programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: Ambulance Girl
programme.desc: Comedy drama directed by and starring Kathy Bates. When paralysing phobias threaten the personal and professional life of a food writer (Bates), she decides to venture off in a completely different direction. As a volunteer paramedic, she finally discovers the perfect way to help herself by helping others.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. Complications arise when their respective attorneys, the equally cynical Emily Bennett and Kenton Rhodes, unexpectedly fall in love, throwing an extra kink into the proceedings both in and out of the courtroom.

programme.title: The Inspectors
programme.desc: Addictive series following New Zealand's Public Health Officers. A visit to a Chinese restaurant with a history of problems, plus a major rat infestation in one building.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Fulfilling his beloved wife's dying wish, William Campbell restores an abandoned building they own into a reading room for a depressed community notorious for its ineffectual high school and street gangs.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: In 1812, young British aristocrat Edmund Talbot travels by ship to Australia and learns more about himself and about life than he had ever bargained for.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Everything She Ever Wanted
programme.desc: Thriller starring Gina Gershon and Ryan McPartlin. Ambitious Southern couple Pat and Tom Allanson aim to rise through the hierarchy of the South Carolina elite.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

programme.title: An Accidental Studio
programme.desc: Documentary with Richard E. Grant. The story of groundbreaking British studio HandMade Films, featuring interviews with directors, actors and the man who made it all possible - George Harrison.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.desc: TVmovie about a widowed police officer and his rebellious teenage daughter who move from Los Angeles to the wilds of Montana. Awed by the beauty of the countryside but dismayed by the lack of urban amenities, the pair struggle to adapt to their new ranching lifestyle.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: Otto is waiting for a very important package, but the conveyor belt at the ABDS breaks down.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 10: In the Shadows
programme.desc: While searching for a KGB double agent who was about to be exposed by another Russian spy-turned-successful author, mystery bookstore owner Samantha Kinsey and her secretive friend and store manager, Philby are thrust into the murderous world of international espionage.

programme.title: The Inspectors
programme.desc: Addictive series following New Zealand's Public Health Officers. A visit to a Chinese restaurant with a history of problems, plus a major rat infestation in one building.

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: College professor J.T. Neumeyer is visiting his wife's grave with his daughter, Jesse, on the anniversary of her death. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a mysterious briefcase appears. Inside, J.T. finds the details of and newspaper clippings about his own murder, which is, supposedly, going to happen at the stroke of midnight in five days.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: To determine whether or not the future can be changed, J.T. tries saving the life of a woman who, according to the pictures from the future, is also suppose to die in the following few days.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: Since the material from the future states that J.T. is going to die in a local nightclub, he decides to leave town before the supposed day of his death arrives.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: J.T. changes tactics by attempting to appease or in some other way prevent anyone with the motive to kill him from getting a chance to do it on the fateful evening.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: As all his plans to avoid his grim fate backfire and put both himself and his family in even more danger, J.T. is forced to improvise and hope that, just for once, a twist of fate can work in his favor as well.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.desc: Mystery with Catherine Hicks. A teenager uncovers a series of shocking revelations when she learns she has an identical twin who has been kept secret from her.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 7: At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: Western about a sheriff ('Dallas' star, Patrick Duffy) who persuades his old friend (Stacy Keach, 'Prison Break'), a retired gunslinger, to join himin pursuit of a notorious gang. The band of outlaws counts the gunslinger's son as one of its members.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Fulfilling his beloved wife's dying wish, William Campbell restores an abandoned building they own into a reading room for a depressed community notorious for its ineffectual high school and street gangs.

programme.title: An Accidental Studio
programme.desc: Documentary with Richard E. Grant. The story of groundbreaking British studio HandMade Films, featuring interviews with directors, actors and the man who made it all possible - George Harrison.

programme.title: Audrey's Rain
programme.desc: Heart-warming drama about a bitter, sharp-tongued spinster, whose future looks bleakwhen she is saddled with raising her nephew and niece after her sister commits suicide. Audrey resents that her family has robbed her of a life of her own, but when her childhood sweetheart reappears on the scene, her life takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: Monte Walsh
programme.desc: Montelius "Monte" Walsh (Tom Selleck) is an aging cowboy facing the final days of the Wild West era. He and his friend Chet Rollins (Keith Carradine), another long-time cowhand, work at whatever ranch work comes their way, but "nothing they can't do from a horse". Their lives are divided between months on the range and the occasional trip into town. Camaraderie and competition with the other cowboys fill their days. They seek work and take a job at the ranch of Cal Brennan (William Devane), where they meet an old friend, Shorty Austin (George Eads), another ranch hand.

programme.title: End of Days
programme.desc: Bodyguard Jericho Cane stumbles across a demonic state of affairs when he prevents the assassination of his Wall Street employer. It transpires that Cane's boss is Satan himself, come to impregnate a woman on the eve of the new millennium and so bring about the end of days foretold in the Book of Revelation. With the help of his partner, Chicago, Cane now attempts to protect Christine from both Satan and a group of priests who believe that her death is the only way to halt Armageddon.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: Daryl Dixon's arrival to France sets off a violent chain of events that inadvertently puts a young boy at the heart of a growing religious movement in danger; Daryl agrees to help shepherd the boy to safety in exchange for help returning to America.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: The escapees' party has got away in one boat, ill-prepared, and after bitter bickering decides to risk sailing to the Dutch Indies. Despite lack of wind, they finally reach Timor. There they pretend to be shipwrecked rich Englishmen and live in luxury on credit for years. When lieutenant Clark passes the island on his way home, he discovers the escaped criminals. William is killed resisting arrest, the rest caught and put on trial in London. The public and press sympathize with the adventurers.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Tel Avivo „Maccabi“ - Bolonijos „Virtus Segafredo“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Barcelona" - "Espanyol"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. Women's MMA has seen Ronda Rousey defend her title from 2012 to 2015 before she was defeated by Holly Holm another belt holder in more than one martial art.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The first part explains the beginnings of the national parks in Austria, which were characterized by the visions of a few pioneers and the civil disobedience of many. programme.title: Austria's Wild Heritage - One Country Six National Parks
programme.desc: The second part focuses on the challenges of the future: How do the national parks deal with invasive species from outside and what success stories can be reported? For instance, in the Hohe Tauern National Park the previously extinct ibexes and bearded vultures have been reintroduced. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: The Kalahari. Land of great thirst. Endless mirages of red and yellow sand merge with a shimmering horizon. Summer rains bring brief explosions of life, painting the landscape in vibrant colours, only to be soaked up by the thirsty earth and returned once again to the desert. In this place of immense beauty, wonder and contrast all that live here are gifted with unique adaptations in order to survive.

programme.title: Animal Fight Club
programme.desc: Documentary series featuring fearsome fights between the biggest and the baddest animals on planet. Watch the animals fighting for their food, territory, rights and life. Follow the drama and adrenaline of the toughest and fearcest fights in savannah, jungles and water. It is an ultimate survival with no rules whatsoever. Uncover the extraordinary motivations and strategies used by the animal world.

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Embark on a spectacular journey around the world in search of nature's deadliest predators. See how mammals, insects, fish, and birds fight for survival using a fascinating combination of hunting strategies.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: Along Washington State's rugged coast, Olympic National Park protects 1 million acres of diverse habitat. Coastal fog hits glacier-capped mountains, drenching the land in record rainfall and giving rise to temperate rainforests. This unique landscape hosts a rich biodiversity, including the endemic Olympic Marmot, Roosevelt elk, bobcats and one of the last Pacific salmon runs in the lower 48.

programme.title: National Parks: USA
programme.desc: As the first national park founded to protect wildlife and ecological richness, the Everglades teems with life above and below water. This land of diversity boasts nine unique ecosystems, each shaped by the wet and dry seasons ebb and flow. Roseate spoonbills, black bears, alligators, bottlenose dolphins and panthers all thrive in the largest subtropical wilderness in North America.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: With leopards in its mountains, blue whales off its coasts, and foxes roaming its city centres, Europe is a continent full of wild surprises. From the frozen glaciers of Iceland to the lush islands of the Azores, and from the rugged peaks of the Caucasus to the metropolis of London, the first episode in this stunning series highlights Europe's astonishing diversity, all shot with breath-taking brio and the latest technology to reveal the continent and its animals in all its breath-taking glory.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe is a continent of diversity, and its coasts are no exception. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife. It's also the setting for some of the world's most jaw-dropping natural spectacles, including orcas and humpback whales hunting side by side, and wild horses running free on the beaches of the Camargue.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe is a continent of diversity, and its coasts are no exception. programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi is in the grips of extraordinary drought. A new litter of lion cubs is born into tough conditions, vulnerable to the attack of a rogue male, intent on taking over the pride. Water levels drop by the day, pushing two hippos to overthrow an alpha bull. Distant storms bring not rain but fire sparked by lightning. In the crushing heat, life desperately struggles to hold out for rain.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Kalahari - Africa's Underground Desert
programme.desc: In the heart of southern Africa lies the Kalahari. It is an ancient desert made up of many different landscapes, with moods just as sweeping and dramatic, that is dependent on what lies beneath its surface: trillions of tons of sand and a secretive community of creatures who shape it and keep it alive. Without them, the Kalahari would slowly wither and die. programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi is in the grips of extraordinary drought. A new litter of lion cubs is born into tough conditions, vulnerable to the attack of a rogue male, intent on taking over the pride. Water levels drop by the day, pushing two hippos to overthrow an alpha bull. Distant storms bring not rain but fire sparked by lightning. In the crushing heat, life desperately struggles to hold out for rain.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 1 of our series starts with the dust of the disappearing migration as it heads off across the river and leaves. Behind them, hundreds if not thousands of other animals cannot move, or won't move, because they are locked into territories, invisible barriers that say to them, 'leave your bubble at your peril'. This is their story. It is the story about what happens between September and the following July. Nine months of wildebeest-free Mara.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe is a continent of diversity, and its coasts are no exception. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife. It's also the setting for some of the world's most jaw-dropping natural spectacles, including orcas and humpback whales hunting side by side, and wild horses running free on the beaches of the Camargue.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: Super Duper Bunny League
programme.desc: The Super Duper Bunny League is a team of bunnies who defends the world from a gallery of cartoony villains. From fighting sweet-toothed space pirates to lava monsters, they use their superpowers to protect truth, justice, and free time to chill.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: After Hazel makes her one-millionth wish, Cosmo and Wanda promise her one rule-free wish as a reward. But when their magic doesn't work, they take a trip to Fairy World to investigate and discover Dev has taken control. Fed up with living in Hazel's shadow, he's teamed up with Irep to give control of the Big Wand to anti-fairies and now kids all over the world have the opportunity to grant wishes rule-free. Before Hazel, Cosmo, and Wanda can stop Dev, he traps Cosmo and Wanda in butterfly net cages and sends Hazel back home without her fairies to help her. While in power, Dev changes Fairy World to his own image and liking, and even reveals the existence of magic to everyone on Earth. It's total chaos. With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

Plankton decides to switch gears by hiring someone who can create the dumbest slogans ever-Patrick! Single Cell Anniversary: It's Karen and Plankton's wedding anniversary, and Karen has gotten Plankton the best anniversary gift ever-the Krabby Patty formula! But she refuses to give it to him until Plankton gives her the best gift ever, too. If only he knew what that was!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.desc: On the night before the election, Clawdeen confronts the shapeshifter and realizes that Headmistress Bloodgood is in danger; The Boo Crew must unite to expose the shapeshifter's true identity and ensure that the election goes off without a hitch!

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: English Football League Championship
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Le Déluge: Gli ultimi giorni di Maria Antonietta
programme.desc: Gianluca Jodice dirige una pellicola, premiata con 4 David e 2 Nastri d'Argento, che indaga le psicologie di Luigi XVI (Guillaume Canet) e Maria Antonietta (Melanie Laurent).

programme.title: Un figlio di nome Erasmus
programme.desc: Le ‘Iene’ Luca e Paolo in una commedia con Ricky Memphis e Daniele Liotti. Quattro amici quarantenni tornano a Lisbona per il funerale di Amalia, con cui tutti ebbero una storia ai tempi dell’università, e scoprono che la donna ha messo al mondo un figlio. Chi di loro è il padre?

programme.title: Chase
programme.desc: Gerard Butler in un thriller sospeso tra giustizia e criminalità. Quando sua moglie scompare misteriosamente, Will inizia una disperata ricerca che lo porta su un sentiero oscuro.

programme.title: Now You See Me 2 - I maghi del crimine
programme.desc: Torna la banda di illusionisti in un action nel segno della magia con Jesse Eisenberg, Mark Ruffalo, Daniel Radcliffe e i premi Oscar Michael Caine e Morgan Freeman. Ricercati dall'Fbi, I Quattro Cavalieri non resistono alla tentazione di tornare in azione, per smascherare Owen Case, un corrotto magnate della tecnologia. Elaborano un meticoloso piano che li condurra' fino a Macao, in una trappola ideata dal giovane ex socio di Case (Daniel Radcliffe). Per salvare la reputazione e la loro stessa vita, i Cavalieri dovranno mettere in scena un vero e proprio show.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: Brad Pitt, Eric Bana e Orlando Bloom nel kolossal ispirato al poema omerico. Dopo il rapimento di Elena da parte di Paride, Agamennone guida gli spartani contro i troiani.

programme.title: Dead Of Winter - Sfida Nel Gelo

programme.desc: Quando la squadra di pulizia di una scena del crimine scopre una valigetta piena di soldi, deve superare in astuzia un boss criminale e degli agenti corrotti dell'FBI che la rivogliono indietro.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.desc: 3 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Francis F. Coppola, con Marlon Brando e Al Pacino. Dopo l'attentato al padre, Mike comincia l'ascesa nella malavita a capo della famiglia Corleone.

programme.title: Il Padrino - Parte II
programme.desc: Al Pacino, Robert De Niro e Diane Keaton nel sequel premiato con 6 Oscar. Nel 1901 il siciliano Don Vito raggiunge gli Stati Uniti e getta le fondamenta del suo impero criminale.

programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.desc: Joaquin Phoenix riveste i panni del folle personaggio della DC Comics in uno sbalorditivo sequel con Lady Gaga. Internato nel manicomio di Arkham in attesa del processo per i crimini commessi, Arthur Fleck si innamora di Lee Quinzel, una paziente affascinata dalla figura del Joker.

programme.title: Le assaggiatrici
programme.desc: Grande successo per il film di Silvio Soldini ispirato a una storia vera. Germania 1943. Un gruppo di donne è reclutato per testare che i pasti di Hitler non siano avvelenati.

programme.title: Hurricane - Il grido dell'innocenza
programme.desc: Un magnifico Denzel Washington nella travolgente biografia di Rubin "Hurricane" Carter. All'apice della carriera, il celebre pugile viene accusato ingiustamente di omicidio.

programme.title: Lei
programme.desc: A Los Angeles, il sensibile e solitario Theodore, uno scrittore di lettere d'amore, intraprende una relazione sentimentale con Samantha, il sistema operativo del suo computer dalla suadente voce femminile.

programme.title: Il socio
programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Grisham, thriller di Sydney Pollack con Gene Hackman e Tom Cruise. Assunto da un prestigioso studio legale, un avvocato inesperto viene coinvolto in loschi intrighi.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Le ali della libertà
programme.desc: Tim Robbins e Morgan Freeman nel dramma carcerario tratto da Stephen King. Mentre sogna la fuga, un bancario condannato per omicidio stringe una grande amicizia con un altro detenuto.

programme.title: Vita Privata
programme.desc: Una psichiatra piuttosto nota viene a sapere della morte di una delle sue pazienti. Presto, si convince che si tratti di un omicidio e decide di portare avanti la propria indagine per scoprire la verità.

programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Hometown - La strada dei ricordi
programme.desc: Un documentario biografico basato sui ricordi di due artisti famosi. Il regista Roman Polanski e il fotografo Ryszard Horowitz tornano insieme in Polonia dopo 60 anni, e tra le strade di Cracovia ripercorrono l'infanzia e la giovinezza segnate dalla Shoah.

programme.title: Le ragazze del Pandora's Box
programme.desc: Jackie Weaver e Lucy Liu nel mondo delle drag queen. Dopo la morte del figlio, ripudiato in passato per la sua omosessualita', Maybelline accetta di gestirne il night club di San Francisco.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Better Man
programme.desc: Michael Gracey confeziona un originale biopic su Robbie Williams, rappresentato sullo schermo da una scimmia: da timido bambino diventerà una pop star internazionale.

programme.title: Red Joan
programme.desc: Judi Dench nella storia di una spia del KGB. Sottoposta a interrogatorio, l'insospettabile vedova Joan Stanley ripercorre la sua lunga militanza al servizio del regime comunista.

programme.title: I segreti di Wind River
programme.desc: Jeremy Renner ed Elizabeth Olsen in un thriller premiato a Cannes. Un cacciatore collabora con una giovane agente dell'FBI per scoprire il killer di una ragazza nativo-americana.

programme.title: Ray
programme.desc: 2 Oscar al biopic su Ray Charles con Jamie Foxx. Dall'infanzia al successo, passando per i suoi controversi lati oscuri, la vita del leggendario "The Genius" della musica black.

programme.title: The Outfit
programme.desc: Thriller che segna l'esordio alla regia per Graham Moore, con Mark Rylance e Zoey Deutch. Chicago, anni 50: la bottega di un sarto inglese diventa l'epicentro di una faida tra gangster.

programme.title: Il talento di Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.desc: Adriano Sereni, burbero e solitario custode di Villa Guelfi in rovina, vive di routine. L'arrivo di studenti che restaurano la tenuta vicina lo infastidisce. Progetta di cacciarli, ma l'interesse di Matilde trasforma il conflitto in un'alleanza.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Peter Weir racconta un'impresa disperata in un film con Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris e Colin Farrell. Evasi da un lager siberiano, un gruppo di uomini intraprende una fuga in condizioni estreme.

programme.desc: Il documentario che ripercorre il trionfo della nazionale italiana di calcio al Mundial spagnolo: una vittoria indelebile che ha ispirato una generazione e riunito un'intera nazione.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son

programme.title: Primadonna
programme.desc: La battaglia di una donna nel primo lungometraggio di Marta Savina. Sicilia, anni 60: Lia rifiuta un matrimonio riparatore trascinando Lorenzo e i suoi complici in tribunale.

programme.desc: Matt Damon, Jude Law e Gwyneth Paltrow nel thriller dal romanzo di Patricia Highsmith. Incaricato di riportare a casa il figlio di un magnate, un uomo e' coinvolto in un tragico intrigo.

programme.title: Mister Link
programme.desc: Golden Globe per il miglior film d’animazione. Mister Link, gigante e peloso ‘anello mancante’ tra uomo e scimmia, chiede a un esploratore di aiutarlo a ritrovare la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Capitan Sciabola e il diamante magico
programme.desc: Avventura animata nel mondo dei pirati. A caccia di un diamante fatato, Capitan Sciabola incontrerà uno scaltro orfanello, un giovane corsaro e un'avventurosa e intraprendente fanciulla.

programme.title: La musica nel cuore - August Rush
programme.desc: Freddie Highmore e Robin Williams in un film toccante e magico. Il piccolo August, prodigio della musica, suona per le strade di New York sperando di rintracciare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: Il Grinch
programme.desc: Animazione campione d'incassi targata Illumination tratta dal racconto del Dr. Seuss. Lo scontroso mostriciattolo verde odia lo spirito del Natale ed elabora un piano per sabotare la festa.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Dall’omonimo bestseller, Julia Roberts e Owen Wilson nella toccante pellicola che ha conquistato il pubblico. Un bambino affetto da una rara malformazione combatte per essere accettato.

programme.title: Stardust
programme.desc: Avventurosa fiaba fantasy con Michelle Pfeiffer, Charlie Cox e Robert De Niro. Un ragazzo entra in un regno magico per catturare la stella cadente che ha promesso alla sua amata.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: D'Inverno lupi e orsi polari si contendono il cibo. D'estate i galli cedroni si esibiscono in danze di accoppiamento e i caribù cominciano a migrare.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: Le paludi e le zone umide ospitano orsi neri e alligatori. Ma anche lamantini, gufi alla ricerca dell'amore e perfino un raro esemplare di ocelot.

programme.title: Jumanji - Benvenuti nella giungla
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan e Jack Black nel sequel campione d’incassi del film con Robin Williams. Quattro liceali trovano una console e vengono catapultati all'interno di un videogame.

programme.title: Ops! È già Natale
programme.desc: Una coppia porta la giovane figlia, Claire, nell'albergo del nonno in Italia per dirle che si stanno separando. Nella speranza di riavvicinarli, Claire chiede a tutta la famiglia di trascorrere un ultimo Natale insieme, anche se è agosto.

programme.title: 100% Lupo
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione tratta da un libro per ragazzi. Freddy Lupin, discendente di una stirpe di fieri lupi mannari, si trasforma misteriosamente in un tenero barboncino.

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Nocedicocco - Il piccolo drago
programme.desc: Avventura d'animazione nel segno dell'amicizia. Per riparare ad un errore, il draghetto sputafuoco Nocedicocco coinvolge gli amici nella ricerca di un prezioso combustibile.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Troppo cattivi 2
programme.desc: Pirotecnico sequel dell'amata saga di DreamWorks Animation con i personaggi nati sulle graphic novel di Aaron Blabey. I 'Troppo Cattivi' faticano a integrarsi in società a causa della loro reputazione e vengono coinvolti in una rapina ad alto rischio orchestrata da una nuova squadra di criminali: le Troppo Cattive.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Blockbuster di Halloween per tutta la famiglia. Il Conte Dracula organizza una festa per il compleanno della figlia Mavis, ma tra gli ospiti c'e' un intruso...

programme.title: Hop
programme.desc: Quando Fred, investe accidentalmente il coniglio pasquale, non ha la minima idea di quello che dovrà sopportare nei giorni successivi. Per salvare la Pasqua, infatti, dovrà prendersi cura del coniglio e sostituirlo.

programme.title: Una notte al museo
programme.desc: Successo planetario per Ben Stiller, Robin Williams e tante altre star nel primo capitolo della celebre saga. Larry Daley e' disoccupato e ha divorziato da poco. Se non trova un lavoro in fretta, rischia di perdere la custodia congiunta del figlio, cosi' accetta di fare il guardiano notturno al Museo di Storia Naturale di New York. Un lavoro tranquillo, pensa Larry, ma gli basta il primo giro di ricognizione per scoprire che al calar del sole le statue dei personaggi famosi e gli animali impagliati prendono vita, creando un discreto caos e dando vita a una serie di incredibili avventure.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: 2 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe al magico fantasy con Cynthia Erivo e Ariana Grande. Nel regno di Oz, l’aspirante strega Galinda conosce la solitaria Elphaba. Canzoni in lingua originale.

programme.title: Mio fratello rincorre i dinosauri
programme.desc: Alessandro Gassmann e Isabella Ragonese in una pellicola di formazione di Stefano Cipani. Un adolescente si confronta con la disabilita' del fratellino, affetto dalla sindrome di Down.

programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.desc: Animazione targata Sky Original ambientata nel Medioevo. L'orfanella Pil vive ai margini del regno. Quando pero' il trono viene usurpato, tocca a lei aiutare il legittimo erede.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell
programme.desc: Il manga di culto rivive in un live-action fantascientifico con Scarlett Johansson. Salvata da un incidente, una donna viene trasformata in un cyborg con il compito di fermare il crimine.

programme.desc: Frank Miller, Robert Rodriguez e Quentin Tarantino dirigono Bruce Willis in un noir tratto da un fumetto cult, che intreccia le storie di poliziotti, serial killer e prostitute.

programme.desc: Oscar a Heath Ledger che nei panni di Joker sfida Christian Bale. In un'anarchica Gotham City, Batman affronta il sadico clown, mentre un altro nemico avanza sulla scena del crimine.

programme.title: Jack Reacher - La prova decisiva
programme.desc: Tom Cruise in un action al di sopra della legge. Un ex ufficiale arriva in una cittadina per scoprire i mandanti di una strage di cui e' stato accusato un cecchino dell'esercito.

programme.desc: Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones e Alicia Vikander nel quinto capitolo della saga diretta da Paul Greengrass. Una nuova minaccia internazionale costringe l'ex agente Bourne a uscire dall'ombra.

programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original con Kathleen Turner, Anna Faris, Toni Collette e David Duchovny. Due sorelle accorrono dalla ricca zia malata con la speranza di conquistarne la stima e... l'eredita'.

programme.title: E noi come st***zi rimanemmo a guardare
programme.desc: Commedia Sky Original di e con Pif, Fabio De Luigi e Ilenia Pastorelli. Licenziato a causa di un algoritmo, Arturo trova lavoro come rider e si consola con Stella, ologramma nato da una app.

programme.title: Scuola di polizia
programme.desc: Cult della commedia demenziale anni 80 con Steve Guttenberg e Kim Cattrall. La libera iscrizione richiama all'accademia di polizia una serie di improbabili e catastrofici personaggi.

programme.title: Ricchi di fantasia
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto e Sabrina Ferilli in una commedia di Francesco Micciche'. Due amanti non possono lasciare i rispettivi compagni per motivi economici. Una vincita milionaria cambia tutto.

programme.title: Una pallottola spuntata
programme.desc: Dopo aver sgominato una rapina, l'indagine su un caso di possibile suicidio porta Frank Drebin jr. sulle tracce di Richard Cane, magnate della tecnologia che ha escogitato un piano criminoso per riportare l'umanità a uno stadio primordiale e ferino.

programme.title: Ma cosa ci dice il cervello
programme.desc: Riccardo Milani dirige Paola Cortellesi e un super cast nella commedia campione d'incassi. Giovanna mette le sue abilita' di agente segreto al servizio degli amici per vendicarli.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - A bocce ferme
programme.desc: Nuove indagini a Pineta nel 18esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre i vecchini aiutano Massimo e la Fusco, Beppe e Tiziana cercano di ritagliarsi del tempo da soli.

programme.title: Bar Sport
programme.desc: Dal romanzo-cult di Stefano Benni, commedia con Claudio Bisio e Giuseppe Battiston. Buffi personaggi si avvicendano in un bar degli anni 70, fra racconti tragicomici e aneddoti leggendari.

programme.title: Benvenuti al Sud
programme.desc: Commedia campione d'incassi con Claudio Bisio e Alessandro Siani, remake di "Giù al Nord". Trasferito per punizione nel Cilento, un impiegato milanese sarà rapito dalla vitalità del posto.

programme.title: Happy Family
programme.desc: Commedia di Gabriele Salvatores con Margherita Buy, Fabio De Luigi e Diego Abatantuono. Le storie di due famiglie si intrecciano quando i rispettivi figli sedicenni decidono di sposarsi.

programme.title: 2 gran figli di...
programme.desc: Owen Wilson, Ed Helms ("Una notte da leoni") e Glenn Close in una commedia 'on the road'. Peter e Kyle Reynolds sono due fratelli gemelli che si trovano, ormai adulti, davanti a una sconcertante verità: il loro padre biologico non è affatto morto ma nessuno, nemmeno la loro mamma Helen, ne conosce l'identità. Decidono quindi di attraversare gli Stati Uniti con la speranza di rintracciare l'uomo. Ma per farlo dovranno ascoltare tutte le avventure sessuali vissute dalla focosa e libertina Helen nei disinibiti anni Settanta. Nel cast i premi Oscar J.K. Simmons e Christopher Walken.

programme.title: Sapore di mare
programme.desc: Celebre commedia diretta da Carlo Vanzina con Jerry Calà e Christian De Sica. Estate 1964: sulle spiagge della Versilia si intrecciano le vicende di un gruppo di vacanzieri in cerca di avventure, in particolare quelle di Paolo e Marina, due fratelli napoletani, e di Luca e Felicino, fratelli milanesi ricchi e viziati. Amori e avventure in un periodo per molti indimenticabile. Sullo sfondo i successi musicali dei meravigliosi anni 60. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior attrice non protagonista a Virna Lisi.

programme.title: Io sono la fine del mondo
programme.desc: La comicità politicamente scorretta di Angelo Duro in una commedia scritta insieme al regista Gennaro Nunziante. Angelo lascia Roma per tornare a Palermo per prendersi cura dei genitori anziani, ma con l'intenzione di vendicarsi di tutti i torti subiti durante l'infanzia.

programme.title: Santa Maradona
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello per l'esordio alla regia di Marco Ponti con Stefano Accorsi, Libero De Rienzo e Anita Caprioli. La vita di Andrea scorre noiosa e piatta finché non incontra Dolores.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd e Sigourney Weaver nel sequel della commedia cult anni 80. Gli Acchiappafantasmi affrontano una forza maligna che ha invaso i sotterranei di New York.

programme.title: La prima pietra
programme.desc: Corrado Guzzanti, Lucia Mascino e Kasia Smutniak in una graffiante commedia sull'Italia di oggi, scritta e diretta da Rolando Ravello. Durante la ricreazione nel cortile di una scuola elementare, nel periodo di Natale, un bambino musulmano rompe una finestra con una pietra e ferisce lievemente un bidello. Il piccolo incidente innesca una serie di colpi di scena e reazioni inaspettate in un dibattito che coinvolgerà docenti, alunni e parenti. Tratto dall’opera teatrale di Stefano Massini. Rolando Ravello è stato fra gli sceneggiatori del fortunatissimo "Perfetti sconosciuti".

programme.title: Ti ripresento i tuoi
programme.desc: Il regista di "Giu' al Nord", Dany Boon dirige e interpreta una commedia degli equivoci. Un architetto nasconde le sue umili origini, ma un giorno i suoi genitori si presentano a Parigi.

programme.desc: Edoardo Leo, Margherita Buy e Giuseppe Battiston in una commedia 'di culto'. Per risollevare le sorti della sua attivita', un albergatore fonda una nuova religione.
